label: Native whey
note: Has no glycomacropeptide, because no rennet touched it; that part only exists in sweet whey.

about.text: The whey proteins of skim milk that pass through a microfiltration membrane which holds back the casein: whey made without rennet or acid, and so the cleanest starting point for milk whey protein isolate.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Milk and whey fractionation

facts.v: 95–98 % from skim milk with ceramic membranes, about 70 % with spiral-wound (cited in the abstract)
At 8.9 °C the permeate was about 35:65 casein to whey protein, against about 10:90 at 50 °C (pilot study, search summary only)
